name: Bloodfray Amulet
description: A wrought-iron amulet set with an amber stone holding bloodfray magic that triggers riots.

timeline.summary: At Udzec, Olrich dresses as a baby and swallows the bloodfray amulet, and Kodolaag frames the minotaur Jitka Wothis by hiding a whiskey bottle in her cape to distract the nullmages.
timeline.quote: Carefully, carefully I rest the bottle inside, hoping it's light enough not to pull the fabric.

timeline.summary: Kodolaag has Olrich cough up the amulet and scales the Exner scaffolding, shattering the bloodfray stone and triggering a massive riot as archons close in.
timeline.quote: The amulet cracks and unleashes a swarm of black tendrils, pressing the light back and turning day to night.
